title: Fine-Tune Readability: Master CSS 'letter-spacing' & 'word-spacing' for Optimal UI & Web Font UX
tweet: Boost your UI's readability! Learn how 'letter-spacing' & 'word-spacing' in CSS can transform your web fonts, creating perfectly balanced text for superior user experience. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UX
tip: Achieving optimal readability and visual harmony in your UI often goes beyond just font size and line height. Subtle adjustments to 'letter-spacing' (kerning) and 'word-spacing' can dramatically improve text legibility, especially for display fonts, smaller text, or all-caps sections. Experiment carefully, as too much or too little can hinder rather than help. A common strategy is to slightly reduce letter-spacing for larger headings and slightly increase it for smaller body text, but always test across various devices and font styles.
